Players Committee card image of [[Our Only Hope (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. OR If He Is The Chosen One or He Will Bring Balance on table, ▲ Yoda's Hut or a Death Star II site.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ouronlyhope.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ouronlyhope.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
